						set_state_flag = wif_demilitarized_state
						set_demilitarized_zone = yes
						# Escalate straight to quintupled from whatever tier is present (or none), duration refreshed
						if = {
							limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_caucasian_resistance } }
							remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_caucasian_resistance }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_caucasian_resistance_doubled } }
							remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_caucasian_resistance_doubled }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_caucasian_resistance_quintupled } }
							remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_large_caucasian_resistance_quintupled }
						}
						add_dynamic_modifier = {
							modifier = wif_large_caucasian_resistance_quintupled
							days = 180
						}
					}
					set_country_flag = { flag = wif_mech_early_100 value = 1 }
					# Remove demilitarization from THIS state only, after 60 days
					FROM = {
						state_event = { id = wif_rkk.31 days = 60 }
					}
					country_event = { id = wif_rkk.30 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

wif_rkk_oil_category = {
	wif_rkk_extra_oil = {
		icon = GFX_decision_category_generic_trade
		cost = 0
		days_re_enable = 60
		visible = { has_completed_focus = wif_rkk_batumi_pipeline }
		available = { country_exists = GER is_subject_of = GER }
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = wif_rkk_extra_oil_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				add_stability = -0.05
				add_to_variable = { wif_rkk_terror_days = -15 }
				clamp_variable = { var = wif_rkk_terror_days min = 1 }
				GER = { set_country_flag = { flag = wif_ger_rkk_extra_oil days = 180 } wif_ger_facade_recalc_rate = yes }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 3 }
	}
}

wif_arm_the_partisans_category = {
	wif_arm_caucasian_partisans = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_army_support
		allowed = { original_tag = SME }
		visible = { country_exists = RKK }
		available = {
			RKK = { has_country_flag = wif_rkk_first_raid check_variable = { wif_rkk_terror_days > 1 } }
			has_equipment = { infantry_equipment > 6999 }
		}
		cost = 0
		complete_effect = {
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = -7000 }
			RKK = { divide_variable = { wif_rkk_terror_days = 2 } }
			custom_effect_tooltip = wif_arm_caucasian_partisans_tt
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 modifier = { add = 40 has_equipment = { infantry_equipment > 9000 } } }
	}
}
